questions.q: What is the article mainly reporting?
options: Nvidia's record quarterly earnings and chip sales
A new U.S. ban on advanced chip exports to China
Jensen Huang's resignation as Nvidia CEO after affairs
Colette Kress's rise from Microsoft to Nvidia's board
questions.explain: Huang resigned after revelations of an affair with a subordinate and with a woman identified as a Chinese spy.

questions.q: Who was named interim chief executive?
questions.explain: The board named CFO Colette Kress as interim chief executive.

questions.q: How much in chips has Megaspeed bought since June 2024?
questions.explain: Megaspeed has bought more than $4.8 billion in chips since June 2024.

questions.q: By about how much have Nvidia's shares fallen from their early October peak?
questions.explain: Shares are down about a third, a decline of more than $1.5 trillion in market value.

questions.q: What does Moorhead imply about replacing Huang?
options: Kress is the obvious long-term pick to fill his shoes
Nobody can run Nvidia as he did, so a new model is needed
Any strong outside executive could easily replace him
Nvidia's operations will run the same without a leader
questions.explain: He says nobody can replace Jensen as Jobs was not replaced, and there has to be a different operating system.
